hinge.title: decide how to read quantities, differences, maximums, and minimums from a pictograph by using its key

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Symbol is the label that belongs on this item, so 'decide how to read quantities, differences, maximums, and minimums' is answered as symbol rather than pictograph.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Symbol is what produces pictograph, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about decide how to read quantities, differences, maximums.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: pictograph is settled by running 'decide whether a frequency table preserves enough information for the': A frequency table preserves how many items fall in each category but removes which — on the item about decide how to read quantities, differences, maximums.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Pictograph is found by dividing the given values instead of multiplying, giving 41 as the reported result — on the item about decide how to read quantities, differences, maximums.

intelligence.enrichment: The quantity in a pictograph row equals the number of whole symbols times the key value, plus any partial symbol's matching fraction of the key value.
